title: 18 more AL/BC patterns: data-modeling, testing, style, security, error-handling, ui, upgrade, web-services, appsource
summary: BCQuality adds 18 new knowledge articles covering data modeling, testing, style, security, error handling, UI, upgrade, web services, and AppSource patterns with code examples and best practices.
key_points: 18 articles document patterns for data modeling (WorkDate, Media for pictures, table-type conventions), testing (BCPT, tagging, test structure), and style (business logic, organization)
Security, error handling, UI, upgrade, and web services guidance covers permission sets, rollback-safe logging, page types, tag nesting, and API write access
Each article includes bad/good AL code samples and frontmatter to support knowledge base training
Duplicates or substantial overlaps with existing files were dropped during review
Updates to review skills link the new articles into relevant code review processes
quote: 18 more knowledge articles generalized from patterns observed across real AppSource/PTE Business Central development
